text: I was a Premium user but I wanted to stop my Premium subscription from automatically renewing. The Ticktick team is playing a nasty trick here because it is not possible to cancel a Premium subscription within the application. Because of that I had to delete my account before Premium could automatically renew, which is kind of sad. But I was so surprised and disappointed to see that I was billed for Premium on Paypal a few days after deleting my account! I emailed the Ticktick team and Appest Inc for help but never received a reply. I filed a claim on Paypal but here is what I was told: "Based on the information we have to date, we will have to deny your claim. Your claim was denied because you did not cancel the billing agreement before the transaction took place". Well done Ticktick, you took $28 from me with your clever way of "forcing" Premium renewal but this and your lack of customer service brought me back to Todoist
